quest.title: Burn the Storehouses and the Stables
quest.description: While on the road, you witness members of a Snezhnayan gang oppressing members of its citizenry. You step in and resolve the problem, but a far more complex situation lies behind this seemingly tiny conflict.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Ishogu
dialogues.text: Who's there!?

dialogues.speaker: Ishogu
dialogues.text: Someone's moving the goods! Help!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Uh-oh, they've spotted us, {NICKNAME}! Time to scoot!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They're closing in from both sides! What do we do...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Up onto the roof!

dialogues.speaker: Meselson
dialogues.text: Bloody hell! That blonde's got up to the train car roof!

dialogues.speaker: Lori
dialogues.text: Stinkin' human thieves. "Young Sire" was right. Humans are a shameless race, just like the Luchkin lot.

dialogues.speaker: Lori
dialogues.text: Nowhere to run now, little crook! Time to die!

dialogues.speaker: Lori
dialogues.text: Come on, human scum!

dialogues.speaker: Lori
dialogues.text: Laying your hands on "Young Sire"'s goods... How dare you!

dialogues.speaker: Lori
dialogues.text: Curses...

dialogues.speaker: Lori
dialogues.text: You're... pretty good...

dialogues.speaker: Lori
dialogues.text: Heh... That all you got...?

dialogues.speaker: Lori
dialogues.text: Too... fast...

dialogues.speaker: Lori
dialogues.text: "Young Sire"... Think I'm... done...

dialogues.speaker: Lindenovich
dialogues.text: You're over the line, Cecile. This isn't your business.

dialogues.speaker: Lindenovich
dialogues.text: Get outta my way!

dialogues.speaker: Sicily
dialogues.text: Luchkin territory, Luchkin rules. We'll be the ones managing this.

dialogues.speaker: Sicily
dialogues.text: Have you forgotten the rules we follow? It's there in black and white: "No harm to families, no abuse of the women and children." Or do you Ismaylovs not remember that nowadays?

dialogues.speaker: Lindenovich
dialogues.text: And you're gonna stop us, then?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did something happen?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like two groups have gotten into a disagreement.

dialogues.speaker: Lindenovich
dialogues.text: One more time, Cecile. One more time I'll tell you. Keep your noses out of this. The "Old Sire" also said this: "Debts are to be repaid. Always!"

dialogues.speaker: Malfa
dialogues.text: Please... Just give us a few days. Just a few more days! You've already taken Papa to the lumberyard to pay back the debt... and Mama can't work due to injury.

dialogues.speaker: Malfa
dialogues.text: It's just Grandma and me at home now... I... I didn't mean not to pay! Grandma and I... We're selling dolls to help with Papa's debt!

dialogues.speaker: Malfa
dialogues.text: Soon... Very soon. We can make seven dolls a day. We just need four, no, three more days! Please. Three more days, and we can pay back what we owe for this month!

dialogues.speaker: Lindenovich
dialogues.text: Three days, huh... That's what the last guy told us. And guess what? We caught him that same night, in the underground gambling dens.

dialogues.speaker: Lindenovich
dialogues.text: No one who owes a debt ever thinks about how they got there in the first place, eh... Let me tell you something, girl. You break trust, and you find yourself slipping down the slope to becoming trash, you hear?

dialogues.speaker: Malfa
dialogues.text: *sob* ...But you were the ones who came early...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! What do you think you're doing, bullying a little girl like that?

choices.text: No coercing kids...

response.speaker: Lindenovich
response.text: And what hole did you two crawl out from, huh? First Luchkins, and now some blond "ally of justice" and a Vila kid...

response.speaker: Lindenovich
response.text: If I knew this job was gonna be this tiring, I'd have swapped with that bugger Lorie.

response.speaker: Lindenovich
response.text: Enough. You bloody debtors are always repeating the same old sob story. I'm done listening to that drivel.

response.speaker: Lindenovich
response.text: You really want to stick your neck out for this lass? Don't you forget the shape we beat you into last time... Hehaha...

response.speaker: Lindenovich
response.text: But if that's what you want... You know the rules. Draw your sword!

response.speaker: Sicily
response.text: I... Even if I get beaten, I won't...

choices.text: Why don't you let me take it from here?

response.speaker: Sicily
response.text: Wait, you don't have to...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh, don't worry, just leave it to {NICKNAME}. No one who picks on little girls is worth worrying about!

response.speaker: Lindenovich
response.text: Pfft. Idiots all. Don't know what's good for them... The "rules" were made to settle disputes between gangs... But if someone wants to play proxy, I don't see why not.

response.speaker: Lindenovich
response.text: Alright then, blondie. Bring it. Let's see if you can back those words up!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Any rules I should take note of?

response.speaker: Lindenovich
response.text: Both sides will use the weapon in their hands, and nothing else.

response.speaker: Lindenovich
response.text: The Old Sire himself taught us to focus on our own strength. Victory or defeat will be decided by our swords and the courage to wield them!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I see. In that case, I've got this.

response.speaker: Lindenovich
response.text: Hmph. You've got more stones than Cecile, if nothing else. Well then. Let's do this!

choices.text: Am I allowed to "draw" my sword as well?
This doesn't look like your average debt collection gig...

talks.objective: Duke it out with the gang members

dialogues.speaker: Lindenovich
dialogues.text: Heh... Show me what you've got!

dialogues.speaker: Lindenovich
dialogues.text: Tch. That it?

dialogues.speaker: Lindenovich
dialogues.text: Not bad... C'mon!

dialogues.speaker: Lindenovich
dialogues.text: Ugh. Got careless...

dialogues.speaker: Lindenovich
dialogues.text: Pretty good. You're fast...

dialogues.speaker: Lindenovich
dialogues.text: Good sword-arm... It's my loss.

dialogues.speaker: Lindenovich
dialogues.text: Looks like your bite's not as good as your bark...

dialogues.speaker: Lindenovich
dialogues.text: Gah... Where'd they find you, anyway... You've got good moves...

dialogues.speaker: Sicily
dialogues.text: Lindenovich... According to the "rules."

dialogues.speaker: Lindenovich
dialogues.text: I know. A loss is a loss. I'll give you two days. We'll be back then.

dialogues.speaker: Lindenovich
dialogues.text: And if you think you can escape, girl, you've got another thing coming!

dialogues.speaker: Sicily
dialogues.text: It's okay, Marfa. It'll be alright, I promise...

dialogues.speaker: Sicily
dialogues.text: Ah, right, and thank you for the help, you two! If you hadn't stepped in, I'm not sure if I could've gotten out of this one in one piece...

dialogues.speaker: Sicily
dialogues.text: I'm Cecile, and I'm with the Luchkins. What are yours?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon's Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Malfa
dialogues.text: I... well. I'm Marfa. Thank you so much!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, it was alright. Also, who was that guy anyway? Y'know, that Linde-something guy...

dialogues.speaker: Malfa
dialogues.text: He's Papa's creditor. Papa owes them tons of money because of his gambling habit. They even took him away...

dialogues.speaker: Sicily
dialogues.text: They're with the Ismaylovs...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And the Ismaylovs are...
One of the gangs in Snezhnaya. They're the biggest, but they're also the most rotten lot.
Their leader, the Young Sire... has been making some real moves lately.
The gang's appetite for Mora's gone up by leaps and bounds, and they've even started harassing women and kids for money...
Utterly infuriating.

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: Ah! I almost forgot to introduce myself. Greetings. I am Sofya Pavlovna Zaitseva, a fae of the Luchkin, one who stands for justice.

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: #You're as skilled as the legends say, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I see I'm famous around these parts...

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: The "outland traveler"... We've all heard something or another about you by now.

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: Well, the Ismaylovs are targeting more people like Marfa, and those people have come to us Luchkins for help... but their numbers are as an endless stream...

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: We carry righteousness in our hearts...

dialogues.speaker: Sicily
dialogues.text: But righteousness will not pay their debts...

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: Well, indeed, justice is rarely worth much Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Malfa
dialogues.text: I—It's fine. If they show up in two days, Grandma and I... We'll have the money to pay up!

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: This time, sure, but what about next time? The interest on Mora borrowed compounds, and you can barely pay that interest as-is...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, those Ismaylov guys are horrible!

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: Many Snezhnayan gangs were founded to protect the people... but the Ismaylovs' have broken with the "rules" as they were first laid down.

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: They've become blood-sucking insects perched on the bodies of the citizenry...

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: It's just a shame that we lack the strength to challenge them. If not, I'm sure we would put a stop to their abuses...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #C'mon, {NICKNAME}. These guys are beyond awful! Let's help!

choices.text: I don't know. This seems like it'd be quite the pickle...

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: If you'd be willing to help, we're prepared to provide some compensation...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohh...

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: Of course, when I say "some," I do in fact mean... "satisfactory."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright, alright, if you're compensating us...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe...

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: Alright. In that case, please come with me. I suspect our leader would have to have some words with you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Your leader, huh?

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: Yes. I have a feeling that Mr. Zmei will be happy to see you.

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: The fae once ruled Snezhnaya, and most in our gang are also fae... but since the Tsaritsa took the throne, humans have been held higher in her favor...

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: Mr. Zmei, being human, has an easier time communicating with those in power than we do...

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: I'll bet he's mulling over what to do about the Izmaylovs as we speak. Anyway, come with me!

choices.text: Well, I can do that...

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: ...Your swordsmanship is first-rate, as is your courage. With your help, our chances of stopping the Ismaylovs have increased.

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: But don't worry, we won't ask you to help for nothing. We have our rules, and they say that those who help us will not leave empty-handed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh, so we'll be helping out and getting paid for it!

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: Exactly.

dialogues.speaker: Soderhan
dialogues.text: Hey, Evgenyi. Wanna get some drinks later at night?

dialogues.speaker: Evgenyi
dialogues.text: Don't remind me... I've got work to do at night. Maybe things will get better in a bit...

dialogues.speaker: Soderhan
dialogues.text: What's your job anyway? Seriously, it's been ages since we've been to Kvasnik!

dialogues.speaker: Evgenyi
dialogues.text: I mean, it's not like you don't know... Lately, the gang's been... *sigh*

talks.objective: Talk to the leader of the Luchkins

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Ah, Sofya, you're back... How did things go with Marfa?

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: #Things went fine... thanks to these two. Zmei, this is {NICKNAME}, and this is Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Ah, so you're the rumored... On behalf of Marfa and all in Snezhnograd who suffer under the Ismaylovs' boot, I thank you both.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, aw shucks, it's nothing!

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: My name is Zmei Luchkin. I... guide the Luchkin on their path.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Just call me Zmei.

dialogues.speaker: Iryna
dialogues.text: Iryna Nikolayevna Voronina.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... hi there.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Haha, well, that's Iryna for you. She's the one who enforces the "rules" here, and has done so long enough that she might appear... a little hard. But I assure you, she's as warm-hearted as they come!

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Iryna's workload has grown heavier ever since the Old Sire passed, and that's weighed her mood down lately...

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: And recently, there's been this ugly business with the Izmaylovs...

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: #Ah, right. I was just going to mention that. {NICKNAME} and Paimon have agreed to help us teach those louts a lesson...

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Oh? Well, that's... the best news I've heard of late, I must say! Is it true? Will the two of you help?

choices.text: My left arm pulses with valor's solitary spirit.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Haha, no one told me you were such a funny person... That said, though, we cannot settle the Izmaylov affair with courage alone.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Let's see, where should I begin... Ah, yes. With the debt collection, I suppose. They've been collecting across a vast area recently, regardless of whether the debtors can pay up or not.

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: Marfa is one such example...

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: This isn't something that a gang would normally do. Do this often enough, and no one will ever borrow money from you again. Even so, the Izmaylovs are doing it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's... Uh, that's gotta mean that they need tons of Mora!

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Precisely, Miss Paimon! They need tons of Mora, and my sources tell me they've been using this Mora to rent many a train carriage...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: To pay for a trip, maybe?

response.speaker: Iryna
response.text: Pfft...

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Ahaha! I'm afraid that renting cars for trips doesn't cost that much... Instead, I imagine they're using the Snezhnayan rail system to move some goods in secret...

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: That's generally how the world works. If you do things in the open, then you'll more or less pay fair prices. But if you do something in secret, it'll cost you extra.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, what are they moving?

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: They're moving raw materials that could very well be used to construct a device that can open a Shadow Realm...

response.speaker: Iryna
response.text: Sofya!

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: #...It's fine, Iryna. If... If we're serious about asking for {NICKNAME}'s help, we should lay our cards on the table.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: It's as Sofya says... Izmaylov's Young Sire is finding a way to open a gate to the Shadow Realm...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The Shadow Realm... Hmm, you're talking about that weird space that we entered along with Alyosha back then...

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Ah, I see you've already entered one such Realm. Well, I'll be frank, everything related to these Shadow Realms is dangerous, whether it's the Realms themselves or the things within them...

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: The Old Sire once prohibited any of us from touching that business. As the "rules" had it, such matters were to be left to the Druzhna and the Energy Commission.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: If the Young Sire does intend to do something related to them, we'll have to move fast to stop him before he succeeds.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: So, the order of the day is to identify the cargo they're carrying... which we'll have to trouble the two of you to do.

choices.text: Isn't this a job for your informants?

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: ...Well, ah, we really don't have that much manpower to spare, you know...

response.speaker: Iryna
response.text: And Sofya failed to complete her mission. In fact, she wound up alerting the other party.

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: Well, it's not my fault security was so tight! Three or four huge Izmaylov thugs were on me before I could get even a little closer...

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: #We can't blame Sofya for that. The fact is that we've crossed paths with the Izmaylovs too many times, and we know each other too well... which can't be said for {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, right! And they'll be less on guard with us, because we're new faces!

response.speaker: Iryna
response.text: Exactly.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, how will we find the train they're using to transport the cargo?

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: We've received reports that the Izmaylovs will be sending a cargo batch from the Snezhnograd train station... We'll need you to board that train and find the raw materials...

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: If you could bring some of that cargo back, that would be best.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Haha, so this is going to be a train heist...

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: A righteous heist for a righteous thief! Theft isn't theft if it's villains you're up against! You know what they say, "steal from villains what they wish to steal, and they shall steal nothing at all!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That doesn't sound like any proverb Paimon knows... Something's getting stolen either way, right? Anyway, it sounds like you already know what train it'll be.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: I don't know...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Or are you gonna make us look for it ourselves?

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Oh, no need. We don't know which train they're using for the cargo run, but we do know who's in charge of the shipment. It's a small Volkodlak who goes by Lorie...

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: So long as we track him, we'll find the vehicle they're using to transport the raw materials.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: You'll have to be careful, though. If they discover you, all that work will go to waste... Also, Sofya will be in charge of picking you two up.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Although... Well, either way, she's a reliable Luchkin.

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: What do you mean, "although"!?

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Alright, alright. Go get ready, Sofya.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: #Once again, {NICKNAME}, Paimon, let me express my thanks for your willingness to help.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh, relax, it's just s— secretly swiping some samples. We've done this a billion times already, right, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Oh, yes, we're old hands.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right!

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: In that case, I'll be waiting here... I look forward to hearing good news from you.

choices.text: Huh, you need my help with this as well...?
My right arm ripples with a lonesome gallantry.

dialogues.speaker: Lori
dialogues.text: Hey, you there. Have tonight's goods arrived?

dialogues.speaker: Shipping Gang Member
dialogues.text: They're already on the platform.

dialogues.speaker: Lori
dialogues.text: Hmph. The Young Sire will have your head on a pike if anything goes wrong — assuming I don't gut you first.

dialogues.speaker: Shipping Gang Member
dialogues.text: I'm watching it personally! Everything will be fine, sir, so please! Please be at ease.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There he is! That's our guy, Lorie!

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: Right. That's your mark...

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: You'll have to stick close to find the train they're using... But take care not to be discovered. Best case scenario? You grab the sample before the train departs.

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: Good luck, you two.

dialogues.speaker: Lori
dialogues.text: Finished checking the goods, Kirov? Meselson, go to the back and get Ishogu to swap with you. Good work out there these past few days.

dialogues.speaker: Kirov
dialogues.text: You got it, chief.

dialogues.speaker: Meselson
dialogues.text: Ishogu? Where's that guy gone off to... You two get some rest first, I'll go bring him back here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Looks like they're changing shifts. C'mon, {NICKNAME}, this might be our chance to sneak in!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #He's at the station, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do we do now?

choices.text: Blend into the crowd and follow him.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah!

response.speaker: Lori
response.text: Hurry it up! If tonight's stock only gets there tomorrow, The Butcher's gonna show us where he got the name.

response.speaker: Lori
response.text: To the station, quick! And get those goods loaded up to the freight carriage in the back...

choices.text: (Try to follow the target...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There are so many people at the station. Are there that many on a normal day?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Where'd he go? Stange... did he go left or right earlier?

choices.text: Let's take the left.

response.speaker: Panicked passenger
response.text: Oh, goodness, Ciliona! Are we headed the wrong way?

response.speaker: Exhausted Passenger
response.text: Morga... I think this is the wrong way...

response.speaker: Transport Bureau Safety Officer
response.text: Ladies, gentlemen, please remain calm!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So many people... but no sign of that Volkodlak.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Uh oh, {NICKNAME}, looks like we lost him...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Hmm, seems we headed the wrong way...)

choices.text: Let's take the right side.

response.speaker: Gaunt Volkodlak worker
response.text: When the Old Sire was still around, he never had us do this much hard labor... I haven't slept a wink in days. I'm going to crash when I get back today...

response.speaker: Strong Volkodlak Worker
response.text: Sleep? Bah, let's have a drink first!

response.speaker: Gaunt Volkodlak worker
response.text: Nah, not me, not today... I'm just... totally beat...

response.speaker: Gaunt Volkodlak worker
response.text: *sigh*

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There are so many workers here, and the boxes are blocking our way...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And there's no sign of that Volkodlak either... We've lost him...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Hmm, seems we headed the wrong way...)

choices.text: ...Let's find a higher vantage point.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, we'll be able to see the whole train station that way. Ooh, there we go, there's a second floor.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, we really can see the whole station from up here...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now, where's that Volkodlak... Ah, there he is!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Look, {NICKNAME}, he's boarded that train. That's the one we're looking for!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Looks like we can jump from here to the train. Let's go!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alrighty, we're onboard!

choices.text: No rush, let's find a vantage point first.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true. There are too many people over here, and we might lose our guy. Hmm, the station's got a second floor. Let's go up and see...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh, we really can see the whole station from here... Hmm, where's that Lorie guy gone off to...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Look, over there! He's boarded that train. That's the one we're looking for!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Looks like we can jump from here over to that train. Let's go!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alrighty, we're onboard!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Here at last... This has got to be the cargo they're moving...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Quick, {NICKNAME}, now's our chance!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Can we... get a sample from these boxes?

choices.text: Your hands are smaller, Paimon, you do it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But Paimon's hands are shorter. You do it! Paimon will keep watch!

response.speaker: Train Broadcast
response.text: Dear passengers, the train you have boarded is about to depart... Please remain in your seats, and be careful of tremors when the train starts...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hurry, the train's about to depart!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Got it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nice! Now we need to get off the train... Huh?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You feel your center of gravity shift slightly. Then, the view outside the window slowly moves backward...\nThe train is on the move.

choices.text: Let me give this a go...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright. Paimon will keep watch! Don't get stuck, now!

talks.objective: Find a way to escape the train car

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we've got the sample, and this bad guy is down... But how are we going to get off the train now...

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon! Over here, over here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, Sofya!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's that? W—Wait, is that a sled?

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: Quick, jump!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ehhhh!?

dialogues.speaker: Ishogu
dialogues.text: After them! After them! Up, up, you runts! Don't let 'em leave with the stuff!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Gotta jump!)

dialogues.speaker: Sofya
dialogues.text: Did you get on? Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon's here! Are you alright, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Don't worry!

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: Phew! That's good. I wouldn't be able to explain myself to Zmei if something happened to you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Phew. Honestly, Paimon was scared stiff when the train started moving. She didn't know if you'd be able to pick us up...

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: The moment I saw that the train was moving and you hadn't gotten off, I started giving chase using the sled!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Good work prepping that sled, Sofya.

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: Well, uh... I borrowed it last-minute from a kind gentleman at the station...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, it's good that this nice guy was there! Otherwise, Paimon and {NICKNAME} might not have gotten out at all!

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: Haha, well, I suppose we should go thank that gentleman later, huh?

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: #Anyway, {NICKNAME}, did you get that sample?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I did.

response.speaker: Sofya
response.text: Great! Alright, let's go. Zmei's waiting for us!

choices.text: Ah, my leg! My leg hasn't gotten on yet!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Pssh, what are you saying? Your leg's just fine!

dialogues.speaker: Izmaylov Guard
dialogues.text: No unauthorized entry beyond this point. Go back to your seat.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Ah. Do you... still have questions?

choices.text: Tell me about the Old Sire...

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Before he passed from illness, the Old Sire was the chairman of the High Table, an organization comprising various gang leaders... Or at least, that was what he was to the gangs.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: But to Iryna, Remusov, myself, and the Young Sire... He was something far more important...

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: He was our adoptive father.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: We were all children he picked up from various places. He raised us, gave us surnames, and then... he placed these organizations into our hands...

choices.text: No, I'm good.

response.speaker: Zmei
response.text: Fair enough. I hope your operation goes smoothly.

dialogues.speaker: Iryna
dialogues.text: Hello...

dialogues.speaker: Iryna
dialogues.text: I hope the operation succeeds...

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: Iryna... You must have had the same hunch I did... The Old Sire was not felled by illness... His death almost certainly has something to do with the Young Sire...

dialogues.speaker: Iryna
dialogues.text: Yes... That is something that he would do...

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: And if that is the case, he has gone too far...

dialogues.speaker: Iryna
dialogues.text: Perhaps he began to hate the name "Nikolayevich" well before we did.

dialogues.speaker: Zmei
dialogues.text: I never hated that name, Iryna. Never.

dialogues.speaker: Lindenovich
dialogues.text: Heh. You're pretty good. Tell you what, a bet's a bet. I'll give this kid three days. Let's go!
